title: Bill McKibben: Rooftop Solar Is a Miracle. Why Are We Killing It...
content: Bill McKibben: Rooftop Solar Is a Miracle. Why Are We Killing It With Red Tape? In many countries, getting rooftop solar or “balcony solar” can be as easy going to the store, buying some panels, and plugging them in. In the US, it’s not so easy.
author: Jason Kottke
